title: Organic Farming: Sustainable Practices Explained
reason: Explains the origins, benefits, and techniques of organic farming.

tasks.task: Explain the origins of organic farming and its ecological benefits.

subtasks.text: Discuss how organic farming emerged as a response to environmental harm from chemical pesticides and fertilizers.
Note that organic farming involves avoiding synthetic inputs and relying on natural methods like crop rotations and compost.

tasks.task: Describe the techniques used in organic farming.

subtasks.text: Observe the use of green manure to improve soil fertility and structure.
Highlight the importance of cover cropping in preventing soil erosion and improving water filtration.
Watch the process of creating compost from organic materials.
Note that mulching is an eco-friendly way to enhance soil health.

tasks.task: Explain the role of polyculture in organic farming.

subtasks.text: Observe the practice of growing multiple crops to reduce pest and disease outbreaks.
Notice the use of biological methods for weed control in organic farming.

tasks.task: Discuss the challenges and benefits of organic farming.

subtasks.text: Mention the need to switch to natural inputs and ensure quality and quantity of outputs.
Highlight that organic farming can support sustainable agriculture and potentially bring new profits.
